Dolphin Watch & Historical Harbor Sail
services.desc: Cruise and sail through the historic harbors near Vilano Beach, as we seek out some of Saint Augustine’s most charming residents, the local dolphin population. We’ll view local bottlenose dolphins as they frolic, feed, and engage in their natural behaviors. Guests will enjoy unobstructed views of the nation’s oldest city from the perfect vantage point, on the water. Fury’s state-of-the-art 65’ Sailing catamaran provides 360-degree views, as guests roam the spacious deck and open air cabin enjoying complimentary sodas, water, beer and wine. This adventure is perfect for cosmopolitans and nature enthusiasts alike, seamlessly blending the historical allure of Saint Augustine with mother

Leave your worries behind as you take in the beautiful city of Saint Augustine basked in the glow of sunset. Indulge in complimentary beer, wine, soda, water, margaritas, champagne, and a variety of snacks, while enjoying live performances by some of the city's favorite musicians! blurb: Guests board a spacious catamaran to experience dolphin watching, historical landmark cruises, live music sunset sails, and special holiday-themed sails. Tours include snacks and beverages, with some offering alcoholic drinks for purchase or complimentary. The tours provide views of St. Augustine's historic sites and wildlife, with knowledgeable crew and family-friendly atmospheres.
